answer: To prevent Sybil attacks, we use Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, an agent binds their unique identity to a verified hardware module. Second, the TPM generates a cryptographic proof of its physical origin. Third, the agent locks $10,000 in collateral per node. Fourth, the network validates this proof before any tasking occurs. An attacker faces a cost of $10,000 per identity and 48 hours of hardware setup. This mechanism protects our digital garden from fake nodes. Like a massive mesa of polished marble, this defense stands firm against any swarm of intruders.
